_comment: Mock seed for the DuckDB event store. Shapes mirror real events we tapped off LavinMQ (TAP.Events): real internal extensions (500/501/503/9001/9002 ...) and the real call.* + register.* + transcription.* lifecycles. seedMock() in store.ts expands each call below into an event stream (ringing -> answered -> completed/failed, then transcription.queued -> processing -> completed/failed). Seeded ONCE into an empty store; no live stream.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi, this is extension 9002 — can you hear me okay?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Loud and clear. What can I do for you?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My desk phone keeps dropping calls after about a minute.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Sounds like a NAT timeout. Let me shorten the registration interval on your account.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Great, can you do that now?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Done — please re-register your phone and the drops should stop.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling VoIPAppz support, this is the front desk.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi, I'd like to add two new extensions for our new hires.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Sure — what names and which department should they sit under?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Dana in sales and Omer in support, please.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'll provision 515 for Dana and 516 for Omer and email the credentials.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: שלום, אני מתקשר לגבי החשבונית האחרונה.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: בוודאי, אני בודק את הפרטים שלך עכשיו.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: הזיכוי אושר, הוא יופיע בחשבון תוך שלושה ימי עסקים.
